d: Get deeper slumber while keeping your room dark by playing rain sounds for sleeping with a black screen! Enjoy the non-stop pitter-patter of rain noise when you settle down for the evening and experience relief as your stress fades away. Next time you lay down for bed, start this sleep sound of rain, close your eyes, unclench your jaw and relax your shoulders to get fully immersed in peace and tranquility. If you struggle to fall asleep at night or can't seem to stay asleep once you do, rain noise to sleep could be the solution you have been looking for. Good night!
